body.spreader_material: Formed annealed 304 stainless sheet; ground via two separate bonded tabs

dielectric.material: Dow SYLGARD 184, separate molded post sheet
dielectric.modulus_status: No measured post-compression modulus. Low values are bulk tensile literature context; higher values expose sensitivity to constraint. None is a qualified modulus for this microstructure.
dielectric.air_cavity: Vented development stack; a sealed air spring must not be silently added
dielectric.mold_process: 150 um laser-cut metal stencil plus a 50 um backing spacer between release-treated flat plates; separate forming mandrels for curved parts

flex.front: One CIN pressure electrode surrounded by its driven shield; coverlay over sensing copper
flex.back: Driven shield plane; never substitute ground
flex.stack_status: Requested manufacturing targets; nominal total 0.186 mm. The minimum-core/permittivity case is a planning scenario, not a fabricator guarantee. Confirm the supplied stack.

electrode_design.tail_exit: TPU cells: negative U side near mid-arc; nail and reference cells: proximal edge. Initial formed routes require independent source/peer clearance checks.
electrode_design.soldering: Two exposed top-side hand-solder lands; no solder-paste stencil. Back stiffener covers the shield transition and carries the wire strain relief.
electrode_design.reason: Reserve 0.30 mm board edge, 0.20 mm driven guard, 0.20 mm isolation and 0.10 mm planning margin on the flat flex artwork.
electrode_design.coordinate_rule: Apply this inset at the flex neutral plane in developed coordinates, then map the active footprint back to the common source surface for matching post tooling.
electrode_design.status: Integration development; existing post masters and capacitance estimates must be regenerated for the revised active area and thicker flex core.

readout.reference: One protected, unloaded capacitor on CIN4 per board, with the same post-sheet process
readout.controller: Raspberry Pi Pico, RP2040, USB raw acquisition
sensor_cable_signals: independent GND return from upper plate
readout.joined_shield_scope: Conservative total-load planning limit when SHLD1 and SHLD2 are internally joined for the CAPDAC-disabled reference reading; no doubled drive capability is assumed.
readout.note: Differential inputs have CHA < CHB. SHLD1 guards sensing leads; SHLD2 guards CIN4 in differential mode. Both guards are internally joined during the CAPDAC-disabled reference reading.

sources.use: Rev C pin map, readout range, shielding, differential mode and registers
10:1 material and cure options; not a force rating
Johnston et al. 2014, bulk tensile/compressive differences and cure dependence; not a post-array calibration
Manufacturer dielectric-property table hosted by its distributor
